unit: accuracy percentage points per second of prepare+train
source: Scalar kept at 0.7 (the geometric mean of the two directions below). Round r14/k3 on the promoted recipe (64/256/768 stack, 9.5 ep, SXM 400 W, n=8 paired, control 75.53 pct / 5.08 s): e9.0 -0.47 +- 0.13 pp / -0.26 s, e10.0 -0.05 +- 0.07 pp / +0.25 s, e10.5 +0.15 +- 0.09 pp / +0.53 s. The accuracy-vs-epochs curve has a knee at 9.5 epochs: k_down ~1.8 pp/s when cutting epochs, k_up ~0.3 pp/s when adding them. So a cut that loses accuracy cannot be bought back with epochs (judge cuts by direct equal-time runs), and a gainer converts to time at ~1.8 pp/s by trimming epochs. Earlier: r6/k2 on the 8.75-ep 96/256/768 recipe gave 0.65 pp/s (rounded 0.7); 128/384/576 (calib, r1) 0.445; 96/256/768 at 8.5 ep (r3-r5) 1.0.
